facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit during a planned shutdown on SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-4100 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-4100 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 22 September 2004 a near hit was recorded on SG-4100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
